subsystems.name: app-bridge-boundary
subsystems.note: The app subpath is a string-based package boundary: import resolution cannot show that the consumer must use the named bridge instead of the runtime barrel or source tree. The fixture test is the executable guard.

subsystems.name: release-artifact-boundary
subsystems.note: The package manifest, release script, and workflow form a non-imported contract for the exact published artifact; Codemap cannot follow CI strings or tarball allowlists.
